from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/bespoke-inbound')
paths = sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
terms = []
for path in paths:
    if path.suffix != '.md':
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    if not re.search(r'CAD\s*75|75\s*CAD', text):
        continue
    terms.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'english_price': 'CAD 75' in text, 'french_price': '75 CAD' in text, 'effort_present': bool(re.search('60.{0,12}90', text)), 'expected_rows_present': 'expected rows' in text.lower() and 'lignes attendues' in text.lower(), 'approval_present': 'operator approval' in text.lower()})
control = root / 'fictional-reply-control.json'
report = {'scope': 'Committed artifacts and wording checks only. Quote acceptance controls and case reports require substantive readback.', 'quote_candidates': terms, 'control': {'path': str(control), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(control.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'top_level_keys': sorted(json.loads(control.read_text()))} if control.is_file() else None, 'files': [str(p) for p in paths if p.name != 'director-quote-readback.json']}
out = root / 'director-quote-readback.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(out.read_text())
